# Comment sync (append-only) with persistent Jira-comment-ID map + rich rendering

## Context / Problem
Comment sync currently identifies comments by **body equality** (a normalized-text
key computed in `outbound_comments._diff_comments`), which is fragile: two comments
with the same text collide, and an edited body looks like a brand-new comment. The
in-code note at `outbound_comments.py` (`"PR #402 … ID-based binding once available;
this body-equality match is the baseline"`) already anticipates the fix. The team
has settled comment semantics as **append-only** — mirror comment *creation* both
ways, but do not sync edits or deletes — which keeps the design simple and matches
the reconciler's existing inbound behavior of skipping already-known Jira comment IDs.

This story ALSO **owns the DC comment-diff dedup-key migration that `3388`
deliberately deferred here.** `3388` redefines `WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound`
from identity to the rendering form for descriptions, but keeps the comment-diff
path injecting the plain/identity normalizer UNCHANGED (via the a32a `_resolve_codec`
seam, defaulting to `_IdentityCodec`) so the description cutover does not shift the
comment dedup key. Flipping the comment path to the real rendering codec — and
keeping comment-diff convergent when it renders rich — is this story's job, not
`3388`'s.

## Approach
Two coupled changes, both append-only and echo-safe:

1. **Stable identity by ID, not body.** Maintain a **persistent map from rebar
   comment event → Jira comment ID** in the binding state, so identity is by ID.
   Outbound: when rebar has a new comment with no mapped Jira ID, create it in Jira
   and record the returned Jira comment ID. Inbound: mirror Jira comments whose IDs
   are not already in the map as new rebar comments. **Append-only**: never push
   rebar edits/deletes to Jira comments and never apply Jira comment edits/deletes to
   rebar — an already-mapped ID is never re-synced (the ID map is the durable echo
   guard for comments, superseding the body-key match and complementing the existing
   `RECONCILER_MARKER` machine-comment guard, `outbound_comments.py:72/177-184`,
   which still excludes bridge-internal payloads). The ID map is change-gated and
   fixed-shape (one small entry per comment, added once) to respect epic `0303`'s
   churn discipline.
2. **Render comment bodies through the codec, and migrate the dedup key.** Outbound
   comment bodies are rendered through the SAME `RichTextCodec.to_wire` seam the
   descriptions use (`adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py` — `AdfCodec.to_wire` for
   Cloud, the now-rendering `WikiTextCodec.to_wire` for DC after `3388`), applied in
   `_map_comments_for_create`/`_decorate_outbound_comment`. To keep the local
   comparison key aligned with the rendered wire, this story **flips the a32a codec
   injection** (`_diff_comments`'s `_resolve_codec` argument, `outbound_comments.py`)
   from the default `_IdentityCodec` to the real `RichTextCodec`, so the local dedup
   key is `normalize_outbound`-consistent with what lands on Jira. Because identity
   is now the ID map, the dedup key is only a secondary guard, so the migration
   cannot reintroduce duplicate re-posts: an AC asserts DC comment-diff still
   converges (zero duplicate re-post) after the injection flip. This is the mirror
   of `3388`'s `test_dc_comment_diff_unchanged_by_cutover` (which pinned the key
   UNCHANGED under the description-only cutover); here it changes deliberately and
   still converges.

Descriptions + the description cutover ship first (`e59d`/`271c`/`3388`, on which
this story depends), so this builds on the codec-rendering + state-echo-suppression
already in place.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/binding_store.py` — persistent per-binding
  comment-ID map (change-gated, append-only, fixed-shape entry).
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py` — comment differ keyed
  by the ID map instead of the normalized body key; outbound create renders via
  `RichTextCodec.to_wire` in `_map_comments_for_create`/`_decorate_outbound_comment`;
  flip the `_diff_comments` a32a codec injection (`_resolve_codec`) from
  `_IdentityCodec` to the real `RichTextCodec` for the local dedup key; preserve the
  `RECONCILER_MARKER` machine-comment exclusion.
- inbound comment mirror path — mirror only Jira comment IDs absent from the map;
  never apply Jira comment edits/deletes.
- `tests/` — comment identity, append-only, rendering, and dedup-key-migration
  convergence tests.

## Testing
- Duplicate bodies: two rebar comments with identical text create two distinct Jira
  comments and map to two distinct IDs (no collision), keyed by ID not body.
- Idempotence: a second reconcile pass creates 0 duplicate comments (mapped IDs are
  skipped).
- Append-only: a rebar comment edit does not push to Jira and a Jira comment edit
  does not overwrite rebar; only genuinely new comments mirror.
- Rich rendering: an outbound comment body is rendered through `RichTextCodec.to_wire`
  (Cloud ADF / DC wiki), asserted by the wire shape a create receives.
- Dedup-key migration convergence: after flipping the comment `_resolve_codec`
  injection to the real rendering codec, DC comment-diff still converges with zero
  duplicate re-post (the deliberate counterpart to `3388`'s
  `test_dc_comment_diff_unchanged_by_cutover`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Comment identity is a persistent Jira-comment-ID map, not the normalized-body
  key; verified by `test_comment_duplicate_bodies_distinct_ids` (two identical-text
  comments map to two IDs).
- [ ] Comment sync is append-only in both directions — new comments mirror once,
  edits/deletes are not synced; verified by `test_comment_append_only` (an
  edit/delete triggers no cross-side write).
- [ ] Outbound comment bodies are rendered through the shared `RichTextCodec.to_wire`
  seam (Cloud ADF / DC wiki), and the `_diff_comments` a32a codec injection is
  migrated from `_IdentityCodec` to the real rendering codec so the local dedup key
  matches the landed wire; verified by `test_comment_rendered_through_codec` and
  `test_comment_dedup_key_uses_real_codec`.
- [ ] After the dedup-key migration, DC comment-diff converges with zero duplicate
  re-post (the deliberate counterpart to `3388`'s comment-diff-unchanged pin);
  verified by `test_dc_comment_diff_converges_after_migration`.
- [ ] A repeat reconcile pass creates no duplicate comments; verified by
  `test_comment_sync_idempotent`.
- [ ] The comment-ID map is change-gated and adds no per-pass churn (fixed-shape,
  one entry per comment, added once); verified by the git-delta cost harness on a
  no-new-comment pass.
